result.summary: FAIL. No expected verdict was named in the task; the verdict is derived from my own runs (AP-018). Scope: docs/workflows/ all 8 files and the cross references to their section titles. Compared each file with the original from a fresh clone of the tag base/TRANSL-20261025-01 (<scratch>/clone-07b). (a) Meaning: I read all 8 English files against the Russian originals section by section (about 2,100 lines each). Rules, numbers, conditions, steps, examples are kept except F1 and F2 (a literal value was translated, so the rule changed) and the small notes F4, F5. (b) Structure: headings 11/12/12/10/11/7/11/13 equal in number, order and level; list items 36/140/29/28/58/29/21/83 equal and same marker type; table rows 14/27/22/16/29/16/17/28 equal; code fences 0/2/0/0/0/0/0/6 equal; the fenced code differs only in translated comment text and placeholders. (c) Identifiers: scripted comparison of every digit-bearing token (all numbers, AP/REQ/ISS/WF/AUD/Q/R, decision numbers), every path-like or capital token and every backticked token: no token lost or changed; the only differences are the translated placeholders (<LABEL>, <YYYYMMDD>, <short>, <outside the project>, <tag>, <path>, <part>, <dimension> and similar) and glosses ('14' in '14-day check', '06' in a gloss). (d) Cyrillic left: 38 lines, every one is a quoted literal with an English gloss (Status/Severity/Found fields of a defect and its section titles, 'closed, <дата>' statuses, «допущение», «неизвестно», «Рекомендация агентов (WF-06)», «Решения владельца», «Ценность одной фразой», «Основание», outcomes «рано» and «проверка на 14 дней», «источник недоступен», «вердикт ворот оспорен», «Агенты должны многопоточно работать», «не выполнен: нет согласия владельца», «образца нет, мерило — описание», «можно перенести», «не подтверждено», «идёт», «готов», «не найдено», 'О1, О2' design question numbers). No Russian passage longer than one line that is not a quotation or a placeholder. (e) English is plain and consistent with the glossary of decisions/0080 item 5 (handoff, gate, run, step, gate pass, write set, mutant, oracle, acceptance, release, bookkeeping, the bar, reader, rework step, base tag, micro-amendment all used as listed); only Low calques (F6). (f) Front matter: 37 role files, every name: line matches ^name: Sai <Role> (CODE)$; node readRoles() returns 37 codes, equal to the codes used in docs/workflows (role codes in the 8 files are byte-identical to the originals). Cross references: all quoted section titles that other files use for docs/workflows (handoffs.md sections, WF headings) were checked against the headings by script: one does not match (F3). tools/README.md section "The handoff command", quality-bar 'Proposal to raise the bar' and decisions/README.md exist. Tests that read these files: handoffs-docs.test.js and handoffs-cmd-docs.test.js re-pointed at the English headings and pass except HO-46 and HO-47 (traces-runtime TR-4b: tools/src/picker/public/net.js is a network file not in the expected list; src is untouched by this run and the failure is the known picker problem, not translation). Quality bar items Q1-Q14, R1-R3: this run changes no code, requirement or status, so Q1, Q4-Q11, R1-R3 are not applicable (no new function, no data, no external call, no Pixel Office events; R1 the merge waits for the owner); Q2/Q3 PASS (own runs below); Q12 PASS (nothing against decisions; decisions/0080 item 4 is violated only by F1/F2); Q13 not applicable (no new process error recorded here); Q14 PASS for this scope (handoff files 01-07 exist for every change, handoffs-check 0 violations). The result in plain words: the workflow files are a faithful translation except for one rule (the word to write for an unknown time) that now sends a recipient into a failure of the check command, one value (FAIL принят) that now differs from the role file, and one broken section title in verdict-executor.md. Fix those and run this gate again.

findings.place: docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md line 350 (step 8, item 5): 'the gate of step 8 is closed without the signature'. Original: 'без подписи ворота шага 8 закрыты'.
